```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(janitor)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(corrplot)
library(tigris)
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

```{r}
partial_results_2026 <- read_csv("../data/2026/results/md_county_results_all.csv")

actual_2026 <- partial_results_2026 |>
  filter(contest == "Governor / Lt. Governor") |>
  select(county, contest, candidate, party, total) |>
  group_by(county) |>
  summarise(total_votes_cast = sum(total)) |>
  left_join(read_csv("../data/processed/2026_eligible_voters.csv") |> filter(party == "ALL") |> select(county, eligible_voters), join_by(county)) |>
  mutate(pct_turnout = round(total_votes_cast / eligible_voters * 100, 1))

predicted_2026 <- read_csv("../data/processed/2026_predicted_turnout.csv")

historical <- read_csv("../data/processed/historical_midterm_turnout.csv") |>
  filter(election == "GENERAL", party == "ALL") |>
  select(year, county, turnout, pct_turnout) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = c(turnout, pct_turnout)) |>
  left_join(predicted_2026 |> select(county, predicted_turnout, predicted_pct_turnout), join_by(county)) |>
  left_join(actual_2026, join_by(county)) |>
  rename(
    predicted_turnout_2026 = predicted_turnout,
    predicted_pct_turnout_2026 = predicted_pct_turnout,
    turnout_2026 = total_votes_cast
  ) |>
  mutate(across(c(pct_turnout_2010, pct_turnout_2014, pct_turnout_2018, pct_turnout_2022), ~ round(.x * 100, 1))) |>
  select(county, pct_turnout_2010, pct_turnout_2014, pct_turnout_2018, pct_turnout_2022, pct_turnout, predicted_pct_turnout_2026) |>
  mutate(diff_from_predicted = pct_turnout - predicted_pct_turnout_2026,
         diff_from_2010 = pct_turnout - pct_turnout_2010,
         diff_from_2014 = pct_turnout - pct_turnout_2014,
         diff_from_2018 = pct_turnout - pct_turnout_2018,
         diff_from_2022 = pct_turnout - pct_turnout_2022,
         closest_year = case_when(
          pmin(abs(diff_from_2010), abs(diff_from_2014), abs(diff_from_2018), abs(diff_from_2022)) == abs(diff_from_2010) ~ 2010,
          pmin(abs(diff_from_2010), abs(diff_from_2014), abs(diff_from_2018), abs(diff_from_2022)) == abs(diff_from_2014) ~ 2014,
          pmin(abs(diff_from_2010), abs(diff_from_2014), abs(diff_from_2018), abs(diff_from_2022)) == abs(diff_from_2018) ~ 2018,
          pmin(abs(diff_from_2010), abs(diff_from_2014), abs(diff_from_2018), abs(diff_from_2022)) == abs(diff_from_2022) ~ 2022,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_),
         distance_from_closest_year = case_when(
          closest_year == 2010 ~ diff_from_2010,
          closest_year == 2014 ~ diff_from_2014,
          closest_year == 2018 ~ diff_from_2018,
          closest_year == 2022 ~ diff_from_2022,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_)
         )
         
```

```{r}
comparison <- actual_2026 |>
  left_join(predicted_2026 |> select(county, predicted_turnout, predicted_pct_turnout, lo, hi), join_by(county)) |>
  select(county, eligible_voters, total_votes_cast, predicted_turnout, predicted_pct_turnout, pct_turnout, lo, hi) |>
  mutate(
    difference = total_votes_cast - predicted_turnout,
    difference_from_lo = total_votes_cast - lo,
    within_interval = if_else(total_votes_cast >= lo & total_votes_cast <= hi, TRUE, FALSE),
    pct_difference = (total_votes_cast - predicted_turnout) / predicted_turnout * 100,
    closer_to_lo = if_else(abs(difference_from_lo) < abs(difference), TRUE, FALSE),
    eligible_voters_rank = rank(-eligible_voters, ties.method = "min")
  ) 

comparison |>
  summarise(
    total_votes_cast = sum(total_votes_cast),
    predicted_turnout = sum(predicted_turnout),
    
  ) |>
  mutate(
    difference = total_votes_cast - predicted_turnout,
    pct_difference = (total_votes_cast - predicted_turnout) / predicted_turnout * 100
  )

comparison |>
  summarise(statewide_pct_turnout = sum(total_votes_cast) / sum(eligible_voters) * 100,
            statewide_predicted_pct_turnout = sum(predicted_turnout) / sum(eligible_voters) * 100,
            statewide_lo_turnout = sum(lo),
            statewide_lo_pct_turnout = sum(lo) / sum(eligible_voters) * 100,
            avg_predicted_pct_turnout = mean(predicted_pct_turnout),
            avg_actual_pct_turnout = mean(pct_turnout),
            statewide_predicted_turnout = sum(predicted_turnout),
            statewide_actual_turnout = sum(total_votes_cast),
            miss = statewide_actual_turnout - statewide_predicted_turnout,
            pct_miss = miss / statewide_predicted_turnout * 100,
            miss_from_lo = statewide_actual_turnout - statewide_lo_turnout,
            miss_pct_from_lo = miss_from_lo / statewide_lo_turnout * 100)

predicted_2026 |>
  summarise(
    statewide_predicted_turnout = sum(predicted_turnout),
    statewide_predicted_pct_turnout = sum(predicted_turnout) / sum(eligible_voters) * 100,
    statewide_lo_turnout = sum(lo),
    statewide_lo_pct_turnout = sum(lo) / sum(eligible_voters) * 100,
    statewide_hi_turnout = sum(hi),
    statewide_hi_pct_turnout = sum(hi) / sum(eligible_voters) * 100
  )
  

actual_2026 |>
  summarise(
    statewide_actual_turnout = sum(total_votes_cast),
    statewide_actual_pct_turnout = sum(total_votes_cast) / sum(eligible_voters) * 100
  )
```

```{r}
skipjack_forecast <- read_csv("../data/processed/2026_skipjack_forecast.csv") |>
  filter(scenario == "central") |>
  select(county, ballots_mean, ballots_q05, ballots_q95) |>
  mutate(county = str_replace(county, "St.", "Saint")) |>
  rename(
    predicted_turnout = ballots_mean,
    lo = ballots_q05,
    hi = ballots_q95)

skipjack_comparison <- actual_2026 |>
  left_join(skipjack_forecast, join_by(county)) |>
  select(county, total_votes_cast, predicted_turnout, lo, hi) |>
  mutate(
    difference = total_votes_cast - predicted_turnout,
    difference_from_lo = total_votes_cast - lo,
    within_interval = if_else(total_votes_cast >= lo & total_votes_cast <= hi, TRUE, FALSE),
    pct_difference = (total_votes_cast - predicted_turnout) / predicted_turnout * 100
  )
```
